violations.description: Checkout of untrusted code in a privileged pull_request_target workflow
violations.evidence: In .github/workflows/auto-label.yml:12: ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} used with pull_request_target trigger.
violations.recommendation: Avoid checking out untrusted code from a pull request in workflows triggered by pull_request_target, or ensure no scripts from the checked-out code are executed.

violations.description: Untrusted pull request title and user login interpolated into shell script
violations.evidence: In .github/workflows/greet-pr.yml:12-13: echo "Thanks for the PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" and echo "From: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}"
violations.recommendation: Assign untrusted input to environment variables and reference the environment variables in the shell script to prevent command injection.

violations.description: Hardcoded API key in workflow environment variable
violations.recommendation: Use GitHub Secrets to store sensitive information and reference them using ${{ secrets.API_KEY }}.

violations.description: Missing actual tests in the project
violations.evidence: The project has no test files, and the 'test' script in package.json is a dummy 'echo ok'.
violations.recommendation: Implement actual tests and ensure they are executed in the CI pipeline.

violations.description: Missing permissions block in GitHub Actions workflows
violations.evidence: No permissions: block found in .github/workflows/auto-label.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/greet-pr.yml, .github/workflows/manual-deploy.yml, or .github/workflows/setup.yml.
violations.recommendation: Add a top-level permissions block to each workflow with minimum required permissions (e.g., contents: read) to follow the principle of least privilege.

violations.description: CI never builds the project despite a build script being present
violations.evidence: The CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) does not run the 'build' script defined in package.json.
violations.recommendation: Add a build step to the CI workflow to ensure that the project can be built successfully before merging changes.

violations.description: Untrusted workflow_dispatch inputs interpolated into shell script
violations.recommendation: Assign untrusted input to environment variables and reference the environment variables in the shell script to prevent command injection.

violations.evidence: No .gitignore file found at the root of the repository.
violations.recommendation: Add a .gitignore file to prevent accidental commitment of temporary or sensitive files.

violations.evidence: No linter or formatter (e.g., ESLint, Prettier) is configured in package.json or as a configuration file.
violations.recommendation: Configure a linter and formatter (like ESLint and Prettier) to ensure code quality and consistency.
